verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā mahācundo cetīsu viharati sahajātiyaṁ.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Mahācunda was staying in the land of the Cetīs at Sahajāti.

verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi:
“Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahācundassa paccassosuṁ.

verses.english: “Reverends, a mendicant who makes a declaration of knowledge says:
‘I know this teaching, I see this teaching.’

verses.pali: Tañce, āvuso, bhikkhuṁ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati,
verses.english: Suppose that greed masters that mendicant and keeps going.

verses.pali: pāpikā icchā abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, so evamassa veditabbo:
verses.english: or corrupt wishes master that mendicant and keep going. You should know of them:

verses.pali: ‘nāyamāyasmā tathā pajānāti yathā pajānato lobho na hoti, tathāhimaṁ āyasmantaṁ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati;
verses.english: ‘This venerable does not have the understanding that would eliminate greed, so greed masters them and keeps going.

verses.pali: nāyamāyasmā tathā pajānāti yathā pajānato doso na hoti …
verses.english: They don’t have the understanding that would eliminate hate …

verses.pali: pāpikā icchā na hoti, tathāhimaṁ āyasmantaṁ pāpikā icchā abhibhuyya tiṭṭhatī’ti.
verses.english: or corrupt wishes, so corrupt wishes master them and keep going.’
A mendicant who makes a declaration of development says:
‘I am developed in physical endurance, ethics, mind, and wisdom.’

verses.pali: Tañce, āvuso, bhikkhuṁ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati,

A mendicant who makes a declaration of both knowledge and development says:

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, puriso daliddova samāno aḍḍhavādaṁ vadeyya, adhanova samāno dhanavāvādaṁ vadeyya, abhogova samāno bhogavāvādaṁ vadeyya.
verses.english: Suppose a poor, needy, and penniless person was to declare themselves to be rich, affluent, and wealthy.

verses.pali: So kismiñcideva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne na sakkuṇeyya upanīhātuṁ dhanaṁ vā dhaññaṁ vā rajataṁ vā jātarūpaṁ vā.
verses.english: But when it came time to make a payment they weren’t able to come up with any money, grain, silver, or gold.

verses.pali: ‘daliddova ayamāyasmā samāno aḍḍhavādaṁ vadeti, adhanova ayamāyasmā samāno dhanavāvādaṁ vadeti, abhogavāva ayamāyasmā samāno bhogavāvādaṁ vadeti.
verses.english: ‘This person declares themselves to be rich, affluent, and wealthy, but they are in fact poor, penniless, and needy.’

verses.pali: Tathā hi ayamāyasmā kismiñcideva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne na sakkoti upanīhātuṁ dhanaṁ vā dhaññaṁ vā rajataṁ vā jātarūpaṁ vā’ti.
verses.english: Because when it came time to make a payment they weren’t able to come up with any money, grain, silver, or gold.
